rationale: The material prompt requirement is Leadership performance brief. At # Next on Vercel Performance, the source is scoped to Diagnose and fix Core Web Vitals and page performance of a Next.js app on Vercel - measurement-first. Use when an LCP/INP/CLS score is bad, a page "feels slow", Lighthouse/PageSpeed/Speed Insights is red, the JS bundle is too big, images or fonts are janky, or you want Vercel-specific caching/edge w; that scope does not provide a plausible route to the required input/output boundary.
